description: This file contains shell script functions for platform-specific firmware image checking and upgrading. It determines the board name and executes corresponding upgrade procedures, defaulting to a generic upgrade if the board is unrecognized.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the firmware image is suitable for the current platform based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process, selecting specific procedures based on the board type.
